prompts.title: Love on Two Wheels
prompts.prompt:
Subject & Appearance
Character: Young man (Face must match reference 100%).
Skin: natural, glowing, blemish-free.
Hair: Natural haircut.
Physique: Slim-fit body.
Outfit & Styling
Top (Layered): Gradient denim jacket (blue → teal → deep navy) with artistic paint-splatter texture over a clean, premium white T-shirt.
Bottom: Slim-fit cream chinos.
Footwear: Gradient denim-textured sneakers (blue-teal colour harmony) with white sole.
Pose & Expression
Action: Seated right sideways on a vintage pastel-blue bicycle. One left foot touching the ground, the right leg resting lightly on the pedal.
Hands: Holding a single white rose gently in the right hand only, left hand is on lap.
Expression: Looking slightly toward the camera with a soft, warm expression (soft romantic charm, no wide smile).
Posture: Shoulders relaxed, elegant, and calm.
Environment & Background
Setting: Floral street café exterior.
Aesthetic: Soft pastel shop exteriors, wooden window frames, hanging flower pots, decorative plants.
Vibe: Warm, cozy European street ambience.
Lighting & Mood
Lighting: Golden-hour cinematic lighting, strong golden sunlight coming from the left top.
Highlights: Soft rim light outlining the bicycle and shoulders; subtle reflections in shop windows.
Mood: Romantic, calm, European café-street atmosphere.
Technical Specifications
Camera Settings: 85mm lens, f/1.8 aperture, ISO 160, Shutter 1/250s.
Focus: Clean artistic bokeh background; perfect sharpness on face, hair, bicycle details, and floral elements.
Keep Person and Bicycle in the frame.
Rendering: Ultra-realistic wide-angle 16K fashion editorial.
Aspect Ratio:4:5.
Critical Constraints
Face/Hair: Must match the reference exactly. No distortion or face changes.
Texture: Crisp textures in clothing.
